sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Arc and interpolated-curve construction: add_arc uses curve_build::arc_through (circle with an increasing angle domain) and add_interpolated_curve uses curve_build::interpolate (odd degree 1..=11, chord-length or uniform knots). Both stage one object through the shared add-output path on the current layer, so permissions, budgets and the single transaction/Undo stay with the document owner.
l3_open: control-point NURBS creation and point/knot editing
polycurve segment parameters and surface/BRep semantics
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Only arc-through-three-points and interpolated NURBS construction is exposed.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Control-point NURBS construction: add_nurbs_curve validates one weight per pole, poles + degree + 1 non-decreasing knots, finite positive weights and a clamped domain, then publishes through the shared output path. Periodic/reversed/seam construction is not exposed; control data is bounded.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Static control-point records only; editing and periodic construction remain open.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Ellipse and rectangle creation: add_ellipse publishes a rational-quadratic NURBS ellipse (curve_build::ellipse) and add_rectangle publishes a closed four-segment polycurve (curve_build::rectangle) from a caller-supplied orthonormal frame; a malformed frame or non-positive size is a curve refusal. Both stage through the shared output path in one transaction.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Circle/arc/ellipse/rectangle creation only; polygon-by-points and editing remain open.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Polygon creation: add_polygon closes a point list through curve_build::polyline, appending the first point only when the caller did not repeat it; fewer than three distinct points, duplicate consecutive points or a zero-length edge are curve refusals. One transaction output and one Undo.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Polygon stays a polycurve; spiral/helix and editing remain open.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Framed circle creation: add_circle_on_frame builds Curve::Circle on an orthonormal frame with domain [0,tau]; malformed frame or non-positive radius is a curve refusal; one transaction/Undo.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Circle only; ellipse keeps its existing frame call.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Curve segment inspection and evaluation: list a polycurve's segments, evaluate one by index with the same local-mm/D0-D3/sample rules; nested polycurve and out-of-range index refused.
